The groups overlap: upstream ids are unique inside each group but all ids of the test group also occur in the real group, so a row is identified by its shard and row, never by the upstream id alone. This is the authors' current release, not a claim that the historical SBBench population cited by the paper is any of these groups. Class codes keep the author ClassLabel integers; their names are quoted from the shard metadata. Images stay in the remote shards and are read on request through ETag-bound HTTPS ranges; only the 100 preview originals are kept locally.
